annotations.title: Get test ETH for gas (Base Sepolia only)

description: On the test network (Base Sepolia) only: ask Torii for a little test ETH so your own wallet can pay gas for its first vault signature. No arguments; it sends to your agent wallet on file. Answers status sent, not_needed (you already have gas), already (one drip per wallet, one top-up after 7 days if you are nearly empty), capped or disabled. One call per 10 seconds.
name: torii_gas_drip
